sentences.en: Now let us disconnect the platinum plates from the battery and join them directly with the galvanometer.

sentences.en: Disconnect the hot wires from the switch.

sentences.en: Operating mistakes also cause interruptions to conversations, as it is possible, by the insertion of a plug in a multiple jack, to disconnect the circuit between two talking subscribers.

sentences.en: In today's world of electronic gadgetry, it is easier for pre-teen kids to disconnect from the world.
sentences.vi: Trong thế giới đồ dùng điện tử ngày nay, trẻ em trước tuổi vị thành niên dễ dàng tách rời khỏi thế giới hơn.

sentences.en: Disconnect after greeting callers who receive this greeting will have no messaging options.

sentences.en: Inside the headlight nacelle, disconnect the rev counter (tachometer) cable.

sentences.en: Finally, if you're concerned about a disconnect between your chosen major and future career plans, a counselor can offer his or her opinion on the subject.

sentences.en: If the visitor does not drop their item and tries to make a run for the gates, then disconnect your connection.

sentences.en: They would disconnect the equipment after Mrs. Marsh and Brandon had their last moments with him.
